bagPolicy.summary: Iron City’s FAQ covers prohibited weapons and security pat-downs but does not publish an explicit bag size or clear-bag rule.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Iron City and Courtney’s lots are free; the Tool Solutions lot across 6th Avenue South is available after 5 p.m. The Backstage lot is closed on show days, and neighboring restaurant lots may tow.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call tickets are available only after doors open for the event; the venue recommends print-at-home delivery for those needing a ticket earlier.

gates.summary: Concert attendees undergo a security pat-down at entry; weapons are prohibited and cannot be held by staff. Everyone, including children, needs a ticket and a valid photo ID.
